what.title: What this repo is
what.description: NFX-Documentation is the deploy and configuration handbook for NebulaForgeX. Chapter text lives only in books/; the site is a reader, not a second handwritten copy.

ecosystem.title: Deploy order
ecosystem.description: Start in dependency order. Do not skip Edge or Identity:
items: NFX-News / NFX-Storages: product services; login through Identity

contribute.title: Contribute
contribute.description: Edit books/zh and books/en. Do not duplicate chapters in TSX. Issues / PRs: GitHub.
